Restored and re-edited, the film hears them talking about work, money, loneliness, health and dying and their hopes in 1965

events.name: Gary Barlow's Food and Wine Tour: New Zealand
events.description: Gary and Jason Manford head to Havelock, gateway to the Marlborough Sounds, where local seafood entrepreneur Maegan Blom takes them through a spectacular maze of sheltered waterways, forested hills and peaceful bays. They drop anchor at her working mussel farm to see how greenshell mussels are grown, before heading back to shore for meal. Then they drive their camper van to Picton to board a ferry for the scenic Cook Strait crossing from the South Island to the North Island, heading up to the bridge to meet the captain, before enjoying a sunny beer-tasting out on deck

events.name: UEFA Nations League: England v Spain
events.description: England v Spain (Kick-off 7.45pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of both teams' opening Group A3 match, held at Wembley Stadium. England won promotion to the top division in the 2024/25 campaign by topping a group containing Greece, Republic of Ireland and Finland, and go into this match on the back of finishing third in the summer's World Cup. However, they face a stern test against the Spaniards, who were crowned world champions in the summer, and reached the final of this competition last time out, only losing to Portugal on penalties. The last time these teams met was in the Euro 2024 final, when Spain claimed a 2-1 win courtesy of Mikel Oyarzabal's late strike. With analysis from Ian Wright, Roy Keane and Juan Mata, commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, and interviews from Gabriel Clarke

event.description: In 1964, ITV broadcast a film about 14 seven-year-olds, which became the longest-running documentary series ever.
